info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Strategy Insights API
info.description: The Corporate Strategy Insights API provides access to detailed information regarding corporate strategies within a banking context. Users can retrieve specific strategic direction data by providing the required parameters. This API is designed for business analysts, strategy teams, and decision-makers who require up-to-date information to guide their corporate planning and investment decisions. Use cases include evaluating strategic initiatives and assessing market positioning based on current business directions.

get.summary: Retrieve a corporate strategy by its unique identifier.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific corporate strategy identified by its unique ID. Use this to access the strategy's components, objectives, and associated metrics for a comprehensive view of the corporate direction.
